```{r load packages and data}
if(!require(readr)){install.packages('readr')}
library(readr)
if(!require(tidyverse)){install.packages('tidyverse')}
library(tidyverse) 
if(!require(MOTE)){install.packages('MOTE')}
library(MOTE) 

df <- read_csv("Data/pbn_only/4.16.26.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
```

```{r clean data}
#Clean stray marks
df <- df %>% 
  # Step 1: Replace empty [] and {} with NA
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~na_if(str_trim(.), "[]"))) %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~na_if(str_trim(.), "{}"))) %>% 
  # Step 2: Remove outer brackets [ ]
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~str_remove_all(., "^\\[|\\]$"))) %>% 
  # Step 3: Remove all quotation marks
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~str_remove_all(., '"'))) %>% 
  # Step 4: Fix stray semicolon in source
  mutate(source = str_replace(source, "neda;", "neda"))
 
#Rename columns
df <- df %>% 
  rename(
    participant_id = session_key, 
    dem_country = CQ106327DEM, #NOTE not worrying about for EDRS abstract
    dem_age = CQ106335DEM, #NOTE not worrying about for EDRS abstract
    dem_raceethnicity = CQ106344DEM,
    dem_genderidentity = CQ106339DEM,
    dem_sexualorientation = CQ106342DEM,
    pre_hopefulness = CQ812220PRE,
    pre_fas_1 = CQ812225PRE,
    pre_fas_2 = CQ812230PRE,
    pre_bas_1 = CQ812235PRE,
    pre_bas_2 = CQ812240PRE,
    pre_bas_3 = CQ812224PRE,
    post_hopefulness = CQ849580PRE,
    post_fas_1 = CQ812225POS,
    post_fas_2 = CQ812230POS,
    post_bas_1 = CQ812235POS,
    post_bas_2 = CQ812240POS,
    post_bas_3 = CQ812224POS,
    rating_score = CQ113301POS,
    rating_text = CQ113304POS,
    dem_weightshapeconcern = CQ812244POS,
    dem_binge = CQ812245POS,
    dem_purge = CQ812250POS,
    dem_restrict = CQ812255POS,
    dem_foodinsecurity = CQ812260POS,
    dem_eddx = CQ812265POS,
    dem_currenttx = CQ812270POS #NOTE not worrying about for EDRS abstract
  )

#Handle free-text responses in demographics

##Identify preset/valid levels
race_levels <- c("American Indian or Alaskan Native", "Asian (including Asian Desi)",
                 "Black/African American", "Hispanic/Latinx",
                 "Native Hawaiian or other Pacific Islander",
                 "White/Caucasian (includes Middle Eastern)", "Prefer not to answer")

gender_levels <- c("Cisgender man/boy", "Cisgender woman/girl", "Transgender man/boy",
                   "Transgender woman/girl", "Nonbinary", "Genderqueer", "Agender",
                   "Questioning", "Prefer not to answer")

orientation_levels <- c("Heterosexual/Straight", "Gay/Lesbian", "Bisexual", "Pansexual",
                        "Queer", "Asexual", "Questioning", "Prefer not the answer")

##Helper: extracts only the valid parts from a comma-separated string
extract_valid <- function(x, levels) {
  if (is.na(x)) return(NA_character_)
  parts <- str_split(x, ",\\s*")[[1]]
  valid <- parts[parts %in% levels]
  if (length(valid) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(valid, collapse = ", ")
}

##Helper: extracts only the invalid parts from a comma-separated string
extract_invalid <- function(x, levels) {
  if (is.na(x)) return(NA_character_)
  parts <- str_split(x, ",\\s*")[[1]]
  invalid <- parts[!parts %in% levels]
  if (length(invalid) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(invalid, collapse = ", ")
}
 
##Put free text into new column
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    dem_raceethnicity_freetext = sapply(dem_raceethnicity, extract_invalid, race_levels),
    dem_raceethnicity = sapply(dem_raceethnicity, extract_valid, race_levels),
    dem_genderidentity_freetext = sapply(dem_genderidentity, extract_invalid, gender_levels),
    dem_genderidentity = sapply(dem_genderidentity, extract_valid, gender_levels),
    dem_sexualorientation_freetext = sapply(dem_sexualorientation, extract_invalid, orientation_levels),
    dem_sexualorientation = sapply(dem_sexualorientation, extract_valid, orientation_levels)
  )
 
##Recode to "Other" only where original column had something but no valid levels were found
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    dem_raceethnicity = ifelse(!is.na(dem_raceethnicity_freetext) & is.na(dem_raceethnicity),
      "Other", dem_raceethnicity),
    dem_genderidentity = ifelse(!is.na(dem_genderidentity_freetext) & is.na(dem_genderidentity),
      "Other", dem_genderidentity),
    dem_sexualorientation = ifelse(!is.na(dem_sexualorientation_freetext) & is.na(dem_sexualorientation),
      "Other", dem_sexualorientation)
  )

#Factor categorical data
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    source = factor(source,),
    dem_raceethnicity = factor(dem_raceethnicity),
    dem_genderidentity = factor(dem_genderidentity),
    dem_sexualorientation = factor(dem_sexualorientation),
    dem_weightshapeconcern = factor(dem_weightshapeconcern,
      levels = c("Never", "Rarely", "Sometimes", "Often", "Always")),
    dem_binge = factor(dem_binge, levels = c("Yes", "No", "Unsure")),
    dem_purge = factor(dem_purge, levels = c("Yes", "No", "Unsure")),
    dem_restrict = factor(dem_restrict, levels = c("Yes", "No", "Unsure")),
    dem_foodinsecurity = factor(dem_foodinsecurity,
      levels = c("Never", "Rarely", "Sometimes", "Often", "Always")),
    dem_eddx = factor(dem_eddx, levels = c("Yes", "No", "Unsure")),
    dem_currenttx = factor(dem_currenttx)
  )

#Separate out multiple select demographics data into multiple columns
df <- df %>%
  left_join(
    df %>%
      select(participant_id, dem_genderidentity) %>%
      separate_rows(dem_genderidentity, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
      mutate(value = 1) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        id_cols = participant_id,
        names_from = dem_genderidentity,
        values_from = value,
        values_fill = list(value = 0),
        values_fn = list(value = max)
      ) %>%
      rename_with(~ paste0("dem_genderidentity_", .),
                  -participant_id),
    by = "participant_id"
  )

df <- df %>%
  left_join(
    df %>%
      select(participant_id, dem_raceethnicity) %>%
      separate_rows(dem_raceethnicity, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
      mutate(value = 1) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        id_cols = participant_id,
        names_from = dem_raceethnicity,
        values_from = value,
        values_fill = list(value = 0),
        values_fn = list(value = max)
      ) %>%
      rename_with(~ paste0("dem_raceethnicity_", .),
                  -participant_id),
    by = "participant_id"
  )

#Make data numeric
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(pre_hopefulness, post_hopefulness),
      ~ recode(.x,
        "Extremely hopeful" = "5",
        "Somewhat hopeful" = "4",
        "Neutral" = "3",
        "Somewhat hopeless" = "2",
        "Extremely hopeless" = "1",
        .default = NA_character_
      )
    ),
    across(
      c(starts_with("pre_fas"), starts_with("post_fas"),
        starts_with("pre_bas"), starts_with("post_bas")),
      ~ recode(.x,
        "Strongly disagree" = "1",
        "Disagree" = "2",
        "Neutral" = "3",
        "Agree" = "4",
        "Strongly agree" = "5",
        .default = NA_character_
      )
    ),
    rating_score = recode(rating_score,
      "Extremely Dissatisfied" = "1",
      "Somewhat Dissatisfied" = "2",
      "Neutral" = "3",
      "Somewhat Satisfied" = "4",
      "Extremely Satisfied" = "5",
      .default = rating_score
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(pre_hopefulness, post_hopefulness,
        starts_with("pre_fas"), starts_with("post_fas"),
        starts_with("pre_bas"), starts_with("post_bas"),
        rating_score),
      as.numeric
    )
  )

#Create sum scores
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    pre_fas_sum = pre_fas_1 + pre_fas_2,
    post_fas_sum = post_fas_1 + post_fas_2,
    
    pre_bas_sum = pre_bas_1 + pre_bas_2 + pre_bas_3,
    post_bas_sum = post_bas_1 + post_bas_2 + post_bas_3
  )
```

```{r identify completers}
df_completed_1 <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(completed_at))

df_completed_2 <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(CQ715055BODY))

#NOTE: I need a better way to identify everyone who made it to the end of the SSI because right now I can only use the date/time the full module with measures was complete (df_completed_1; but I will probably want to impute data for everyone who makes it to the end of the SSI itself) or the last interactive screen of the SSI (df_completed_2; but people may have still finished the SSI and just skipped this item). For the EDRS abstract, I will report df_completed_2 as the SSI completion rate but use df_completed_1 for all analyses.

#NOTE: the EDRS abstract will just use drop missing data with pairwise deletion (will ultimately need a method for imputing data)
```

```{r acceptability}
df_completed_1 %>%
  summarize(
    mean = mean(rating_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(rating_score, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r pre post}
#Summary statistics
summary_stats <- df_completed_1 %>%
  mutate(
    hopefulness_change = post_hopefulness - pre_hopefulness,
    fas_change = post_fas_sum - pre_fas_sum,
    bas_change = post_bas_sum - pre_bas_sum
  ) %>%
  select(pre_hopefulness, post_hopefulness,
         pre_fas_sum, post_fas_sum,
         pre_bas_sum, post_bas_sum,
         hopefulness_change, fas_change, bas_change) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    across(everything(), list(mean = mean, sd = sd), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

#Effect sizes
dz_hopefulness <- d.dep.t.diff(
  mdiff = summary_stats$hopefulness_change_mean,
  sddiff = summary_stats$hopefulness_change_sd,
  n = summary_stats$n,
  a = .05
) %>%
  pluck("estimate")

dz_fas <- d.dep.t.diff(
  mdiff = summary_stats$fas_change_mean,
  sddiff = summary_stats$fas_change_sd,
  n = summary_stats$n,
  a = .05
) %>%
  pluck("estimate")

dz_bas <- d.dep.t.diff(
  mdiff = summary_stats$bas_change_mean,
  sddiff = summary_stats$bas_change_sd,
  n = summary_stats$n,
  a = .05
) %>%
  pluck("estimate")
```
